# OmniSift

OmniSift, also known as 知漏, is an iOS AI knowledge capture app. It lets users collect text, links, articles, screenshots, copied images, and copied Xiaohongshu links, then turns those fragments into structured cards that light up a personal knowledge star map and inform a knowledge compass.

## Core pages

- Product: https://omnisift.app/

## Key facts

- Platform: iOS
- Current release: v1.0.0 is live on the App Store
- Availability: globally released through App Store Connect
- Category: Productivity / Reference
- Input types: text, links, articles, screenshots, copied images, copied Xiaohongshu links
- Capture entrypoints: iOS Share Sheet and clipboard-assisted capture with user confirmation
- Output: title, summary, highlights, tags, named entities, semantic relations, readable Markdown original when source text is available, related insights, topic constellations, knowledge star map, compass guidance
- Account requirement: no account required
- Analytics and tracking: no analytics services, advertising frameworks, or tracking technologies
- Storage: processed knowledge cards are stored locally on device
- Cloud processing: text explicitly shared to OmniSift is sent to cloud AI for processing only
- Cloud AI service listed in privacy policy: zaimaai.cn
- Subscription handling: Apple App Store payment system via RevenueCat
- Subscription availability: Pro subscriptions are handled by Apple and may depend on App Store subscription review/availability

## Pricing

- Free: 5 AI processing uses per day
- OmniSift Pro: designed for 50 AI processing uses per day
- Planned first-release Pro price: ¥12/month or ¥68/year when available through App Store subscriptions

## Short description

OmniSift is for people who find useful ideas in ChatGPT, Claude, Safari, Notes, WeChat, Xiaohongshu, X, screenshots, and other iOS apps. Instead of manually copying snippets into a note app, they can send or copy content to OmniSift, receive a structured knowledge card, watch topic constellations light up, and use the knowledge compass to decide what to search, compare, or collect next.

The first-card page is a guided Safari starter page for testing the iOS Share Sheet flow and creating a first OmniSift knowledge card.

Capture-first note-taking on iPhone means saving the useful fragment before deciding where it belongs. OmniSift supports this workflow for AI answers, web paragraphs, chat messages, screenshots, links, and other scattered inputs.

## Chinese description

知漏是一款 iOS AI 知识捕获应用。用户可以通过系统分享菜单和确认后的剪贴板辅助采集，从任意 App 保存文本、链接、文章、截图、复制图片和小红书链接；知漏会将这些碎片整理成结构化知识卡片，点亮个人知识星图，并通过知识罗盘提示下一步探索路线。卡片保存在设备本地，无需注册账号。
